title: Prompt (prompt/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under prompt/. The file stem is the spec id and filename_prefix suffix. Specified-prompt image generation; not cartesian LoRA training rows.

lora.description: Optional LoRA applied via ComfyUI LoraLoader. One per prompt. Omit lora entirely when unused.

id.description: Filename on the ComfyUI server under models/loras, including optional subfolders (e.g. style/foo.safetensors).

strength_model.description: ComfyUI LoraLoader strength_model. When omitted, 1 is used.

strength_clip.description: ComfyUI LoraLoader strength_clip. When omitted, 1 is used.

pose.description: Optional pose. Omit pose entirely when unused.

id.description: Filename on the ComfyUI server under input.

positive.description: Positive prompt tags, joined for ComfyUI. Trigger words belong here. Empty emits no positive tags.

negative.description: Negative prompt tags, joined for ComfyUI. Empty emits no negative tags.
